title: Chinese economy weakens as consumer spending and factory output slows
summary: Economists split on need for new Beijing stimulus amid headwinds from Trump tariffs and crisis-hit property sector Business live – latest updates China’s economy showed further signs of weakness last month, with important data revealing factory output and consumption rising at their weakest pace for about a year. The disappointing data adds pressure on Beijing to roll out more stimulus to fend off a sharp slowdown in the world’s second-largest economy, which has struggled to fully recover from the Covid-19 pandemic, with a debt crisis denting its once-booming property sector and exports facing stronger headwinds. title: ICG Raises €3.15 Billion for Second European Infrastructure Fund
